notes: Tekezé Dam’s 420 m double-curvature arch, four recessed midlevel outlets, upstream gate headworks, power intake crane and south thrust block. The crest follows the river mouth and reservoir-facing rock shoulders. The dam section, approach tie, headwork dimensions and outlet machinery are exterior approximations. The retained standard field places the sampled reservoir about 128 m below the design fixture. The design fixture clips water at the modeled upstream face and uses an illustrative downstream corridor based on the mapped river line. The underground generating station, bypass tunnels and operating flows are outside the exterior model.
